tasks.subject: Task 1: Scaffold — head, design tokens, nav skeleton
tasks.description:
**Goal:** New index.html (head, nav, empty section landmarks) + css/style.css (tokens+reset+base+nav), using the Claude Design bundle as visual ground truth.

**Files:** Create index.html, css/style.css, mockups/_extracted.html (temp ref)

**Acceptance Criteria:** head metadata preserved + title rebranded + UA tag removed; fonts + Cloudflare beacon placeholder linked; style.css warm-editorial tokens+reset+base+nav; page loads cream with nav, console clean.

**Verify:** python -m http.server 8765 → load / → cream page, nav, branded title, clean console

```json:metadata
{"files":["index.html","css/style.css","mockups/_extracted.html"],"verifyCommand":"python -m http.server 8765 then load /","acceptanceCriteria":["head metadata preserved, title rebranded, UA removed","fonts + Cloudflare beacon placeholder linked","tokens+reset+base+nav in style.css","page loads cream with nav, console clean"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Hero section + Now pill
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Hero (eyebrow, headline, bio, photo, CTA + inline-SVG social, Now pill).

**Files:** Modify index.html (#hero), css/style.css

**Acceptance Criteria:** headline with muted-tint second sentence; circular photo right/desktop stacked/mobile; Get in touch + GitHub/LinkedIn SVG links; Now pill; renders JS-disabled.

**Verify:** render / at 1280 + 390px, compare to _extracted.html hero, JS-off check

```json:metadata
{"files":["index.html","css/style.css"],"verifyCommand":"render / at 1280 and 390, JS off","acceptanceCriteria":["headline muted-tint second sentence","circular photo responsive","CTA + social SVG links work","Now pill present","renders JS-disabled"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Experience section (native expandable rows)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Click-to-expand experience via <details>/<summary>; works without JS, keyboard-accessible, first row open.

**Files:** Modify index.html (#work), css/style.css

**Acceptance Criteria:** all roles incl. grouped older ones; expand via click + keyboard; first row open + works JS-disabled; title/org/years + detail.

**Verify:** click rows, keyboard-toggle, disable JS

```json:metadata
{"files":["index.html","css/style.css"],"verifyCommand":"click + keyboard + JS-off","acceptanceCriteria":["all roles incl grouped","click + keyboard toggle","first row open, JS-disabled works","title/org/years + detail"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Projects section (commented-out until content)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Projects markup + card styles, shipped commented-out until user supplies 2–4 real projects.

**Files:** Modify index.html (#projects), css/style.css

**Acceptance Criteria:** styled card-grid template in an HTML comment; responsive 1/2/3-col when populated; no empty gap when commented.

**Verify:** uncomment 3 sample cards, render, re-comment

```json:metadata
{"files":["index.html","css/style.css"],"verifyCommand":"uncomment sample cards, render, re-comment","acceptanceCriteria":["card grid as comment template","responsive grid when populated","no gap when commented"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Education + Off-the-clock gallery + footer CTA
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Compact Education list, interests gallery, dark footer CTA with mailto.

**Files:** Modify index.html (#education, #offclock, footer#contact), css/style.css

**Acceptance Criteria:** 3 schools compact; interests blurb + lazy responsive gallery; dark footer with mailto + links + copyright; no web3forms form.

**Verify:** render 3 blocks; grep -i web3forms index.html (none); gallery lazy-loads

```json:metadata
{"files":["index.html","css/style.css"],"verifyCommand":"render blocks; grep -i web3forms","acceptanceCriteria":["compact education (3 schools)","blurb + lazy gallery","dark footer mailto+links+copyright","no web3forms"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: JavaScript progressive enhancement (js/main.js)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Active-nav highlighting via IntersectionObserver; site fully works without the file.

**Files:** Create js/main.js

**Acceptance Criteria:** nav .active updates on scroll; no errors, no library deps; site works with file removed.

**Verify:** scroll, rename main.js + reload, console

```json:metadata
{"files":["js/main.js"],"verifyCommand":"scroll + delete-test + console","acceptanceCriteria":["active-nav on scroll","no errors/deps","works without file"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Optimize images
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Re-encode page photos small with explicit dims; update OG image if renamed.

**Files:** Modify img/* (profile, bike4, bike3, hiroshima, hong_kong); possibly index.html

**Acceptance Criteria:** each referenced image < ~150KB; profile re-encoded to sized square; first-load < 300KB excl fonts.

**Verify:** ls -la img/; DevTools Network total < 300KB

```json:metadata
{"files":["img/profile2a_small.png","img/bike4.jpg","img/bike3.jpg","img/hiroshima.jpg","img/hong_kong.jpg","index.html"],"verifyCommand":"ls -la img/; Network < 300KB","acceptanceCriteria":["each image < ~150KB","profile sized square","first-load < 300KB"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: Remove legacy stack + update README + drop mockups
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Delete unused legacy stack + refresh README; new site already stands alone.

**Files:** Delete vendor/, scss/, css/resume.css, js/resume.js, js/resume.min.js, mockups/; modify README.md

**Acceptance Criteria:** legacy dirs/files + mockups removed; no bootstrap/jquery/font-awesome/devicons/simple-line-icons/web3forms/UA- references; site still renders; README updated.

**Verify:** grep -riE 'bootstrap|jquery|font-awesome|devicons|simple-line-icons|web3forms|UA-[0-9]' --include=*.html --include=*.css --include=*.js . (none); reload /

```json:metadata
{"files":["vendor/","scss/","css/resume.css","js/resume.js","js/resume.min.js","mockups/","README.md"],"verifyCommand":"grep -riE legacy refs (none); reload /","acceptanceCriteria":["legacy + mockups removed","no legacy/UA/web3forms refs","site renders","README updated"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: Final QA + insert pending content + open PR
tasks.description:
**Goal:** End-to-end QA across viewports/states, fold in projects + Cloudflare token if provided, open PR.

**Files:** Modify index.html (uncomment/fill Projects; replace CF_TOKEN_PLACEHOLDER)

**Acceptance Criteria:** renders 390/768/1280; readable JS-disabled + rows expand; all links resolve; alt text + focus styles; first-load < 300KB; pending content folded in if provided; PR opened.

**Verify:** screenshot 3 widths; JS-off; link/focus/alt checks; weight check

```json:metadata
{"files":["index.html"],"verifyCommand":"screenshot 390/768/1280; JS-off; link/focus/alt; weight<300KB","acceptanceCriteria":["renders 3 widths","JS-disabled readable, rows expand","links resolve","alt + focus styles","first-load < 300KB","pending content folded in","PR opened"]}
```
